reasons: No test is visible in the packet.
The redirect runs in the browser, so visitors see a loading line first.

terms.meaning: A library for building web screens out of reusable pieces.
A reusable piece of a screen, such as a page or a button.
Sending the browser to a different address.
The folder prefix the whole app is served under.
The description the app reads to list and open its tools.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Header note and target address
sections.what: The header comment describes this as the analyst-only interface for the tool. The address is built from the app's base path and points to the main lessons-learnt tool.
sections.why: Likely reason: building the address from the base path lets it work when the app is served from a sub-folder. The reason for the header wording is not stated.
sections.watch_out: If the base path setting changes, this address changes with it.

sections.name: LessonsLearntV2Page
sections.title: Redirect page
sections.what: When shown, this page asks the browser to replace itself with the main tool and displays a short Opening Lessons Learnt line in the meantime.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the old address working. Not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Because the page is replaced rather than added to history, the back button will not return to it.

sections.name: tool
sections.title: Tool registry entry
sections.what: Describes the tool to the app: its name, one-line subtitle, a LIVE status, an icon, its address and its page component. The app uses these to list and open the tool.
sections.why: Likely reason: the app needs one description per tool to build its tool list.
sections.watch_out: The status and address must match what the app expects. The subtitle is also duplicated in metadata.ts.

summary: A placeholder for the old second-version address of the Lessons Learned tool. It sends visitors straight to the main lessons-learnt tool and also describes this entry to the app.
purpose: Keep an old address working by sending people to the current tool.
why: Likely reason: the tool moved to the lessons-learnt address. The code does not state this history.
how: 1. Builds the target address from the app's base path. 2. When the page is shown, asks the browser to replace it with the target. 3. Shows a short loading line while that happens. 4. Provides the tool description (name, subtitle, status, icon, address and page component) for the app's tool list.
inputs: The base path supplied by the build tool. No user input.
outputs: A browser redirect with a short loading message, and a tool description for the app's registry.
risks: The redirect runs in the browser, so the loading line appears briefly. A wrong base path sends visitors to a broken link. The name, subtitle, status and address are duplicated in metadata.ts.
debug: If visitors stay on the loading line, check that the target address exists and that the base path is correct. If the tool is missing from the menu, check the registry entry and its status field.
